The '''Opal Foundation''' was a front company for an [[Unidentified crime lord (Opal Foundation)|influential crime lord]] who was terrified of war during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] outbid the Empire and hired away a number of prized [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] for protection.
